messages:
Sam (AE): Quick heads-up — AcmeBank POC asked for SOC2 artifacts, a signed pen-test attestation, and a short runbook showing where logs/retention live. They also want to know if on-prem KMS changes Dedicated pricing. Can @Priya / @Jordan own the technical checklist?
Priya (SE): Yep. Which deployment for the POC — hosted, dedicated, or private? That changes what we can share and what we need to redact.
Sam (AE): It's a Dedicated trial (reserved GPUs). Target compliance review meeting with their security team next Wed EOD.
Jordan (Security): Ok. High-level: we can provide SOC2 Type II report summary, control mapping (CSV), and an internal vuln-scan summary. We cannot share third-party vendor reports or raw internal logs. We can sign a pen-test attestation letter that confirms we ran internal scans and will provide remediation timelines for POC scope, but we don't sign off on customer-run red-team results.
Sam (AE): Good to know. Can you draft the attestation template? They asked for a signed PDF they can attach to their risk review.
Jordan (Security): I'll draft a one-page attestation. It will state scope limited to Redwood-managed infra for the POC model endpoints and exclude customer-managed keys. Also need to confirm whether we can provide a presigned bundle containing: SOC2_summary.pdf, control_matrix.csv, vuln_scan_summary.pdf, runbook.md.
docs-bot: SOC2 artifact package available at https://redwood-artefacts.example.com/presigned/abcd-POC (expires in 7 days) :package:
Olivia (Sales Ops): Pricing note — Dedicated with customer-managed (on-prem) KMS + isolated VPC adds non-recurring on-boarding + an operational uplift. For a short POC we typically add a one-time integration fee of $10k and a 20% uplift on the reserved capacity monthly rate. I can put numbers into the quote if you want.
Sam (AE): Please do — they asked for the delta vs standard Dedicated pricing.
Priya (SE): For the runbook/checklist — I sketched the minimal items the security reviewer will expect. Feel free to paste into the customer thread:
```
- Deployment scope: Dedicated (region), model version, expected max tokens/sec
- Data residency & network diagram (eg. VPC peering / allowed IPs)
- Key management: KMS ownership (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed), rotation policy
- Logging/retention: request logs location, retention period, access controls
- Vulnerability evidence: internal vuln-scan summary + remediation status
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter confirming internal scans and scope
- Contacts: security lead + SE for triage during POC
```
Jordan (Security): Addendum: if customer insists on full pen-test report we need a legal redline and additional CYA. For the POC attestation I'll include clause: "this attestation is for risk assessment purposes only and does not substitute for a third-party pen test report."
Olivia (Sales Ops): Quote draft: base-dedicated = $MM/month (placeholder), onboarding = $10,000 one-time, dedicated uplift = +20% monthly. If they want a long-term single-tenant contract, we can discuss deeper discounts.
Sam (AE): Thanks all. Next steps: @Jordan draft attestation PDF and upload to the presigned bundle; @Priya finalize runbook.md and control_matrix.csv; @Olivia put numbers into a short delta worksheet and send to me by EOD tomorrow. I'll share the presigned link with AcmeBank security.
Jordan (Security): On it. I should have the draft attestation by EOD today for review.
Priya (SE): I'll finish the runbook checklist and control matrix by tomorrow morning.
Olivia (Sales Ops): I'll add the pricing delta and send the worksheet.
Sam (AE): Awesome — ping me once uploads are live. :thumbsup:
